source: Worker Expression of Interest (EOI) Points Grid — Alberta Advantage Immigration Program
note: EOI 抽选制,无及格线(passMark null):AAIP 按月从池中定向邀请。法语(NCLC)列与「英法取高」规则未建模——档案只有单一 CLB 值,按英语列计,英法双语加分保留为勾选项。cert1y(一年证书)会保守落 0(引擎学历梯度无 certificate 档,官方 Diploma/Certificate 行为 4 分);Trades 证书持有人经引擎匹配拿 Diploma/Certificate 的 4 分(官方 7)——两处都只低不高。

education.note: Diploma/Certificate 行置于 Trades 行前:两行学历梯度同档,引擎取先出现者——普通大专不得白拿 Trades 的 7 分(红线⑤保守默认)

bonus.label: Location of Highest Level of Education Completed in Canada: Completed in Alberta
Location of Highest Level of Education Completed in Canada: Completed in another province or territory (not Alberta)
Bilingual language proficiency: CLB or NCLC score of 4 or higher in both English and French

language.note: 英语列;官方对英/法各评一列取高,法语列(NCLC 6+:8 / 5:5 / 4:3)未建模

rows.label: Total Work Experience: 12 or more months
Total Work Experience: Less than 6 months

workMonths.note: 含加拿大与海外全部经验;按月计,引擎由总经验年数换算(保守取下界)

bonus.label: 6 months or more work experience in Alberta
6 months or more work experience in another province or territory in Canada (not Alberta)
Family member (parent, child, or sibling) living in Alberta who is a Canadian Citizen or permanent resident over 18 years of age

rows.label: Job offer for permanent full-time employment in Alberta

bonus.label: Endorsement letter from a designated community in the Rural Renewal Stream
Job offer for the tourism and hospitality sector from an employer who is a member of a required sector association under the Tourism and Hospitality Stream
Job offer in a law enforcement occupation from an employer who is a member of the Alberta Association of Chiefs of Police (AACP)
Alberta job offer location: Rural Renewal Stream designated community
Alberta job offer location: Other Alberta community (outside the Edmonton and Calgary Census Metropolitan Areas and Rural Renewal Stream designated communities)

offerArea.note: 官方另有 Calgary CMA 0 分、Edmonton CMA 0 分两行(0 分不进勾选面,不影响总分)

bonus.label: Job offer in a regulated occupation in Alberta and holds certification or licensing demonstrating meets regulatory requirements to practice the occupation in Alberta
